verdict.rationale: Square documents a broad public REST API surface covering Payments, Refunds, Disputes, Payouts, Invoices, Subscriptions, OAuth and webhooks. It adds a GraphQL API, an interactive API Explorer, official SDKs, idempotency and pagination conventions, and a live llms.txt with explicit agent guidance, which a probe confirmed. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the API end to end, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probes found none at standard paths).
